long_biography.plain_text:
Aspen real-estate broker Craig Morris worked with fellow agent Andrew Ernemann to market a sprawling Woody Creek ranch. They used aerial imagery, individual home tours and a virtual-reality showroom to introduce prospective buyers to the property. Their campaign combined a dedicated website with photography and film, allowing buyers to explore a complex spread of homes and recreational land.

Morris also works alongside his son AJ, who returned to Aspen after a professional golfing career. Together they represented buyers acquiring neighbouring land to prevent large new houses from obstructing their views and affecting an elk migration route.
